ScootRadar

ScootRadar for Android, every shared e-scooter around you on one map, built without Google's libraries and signed with ScootRadar's own key. If your ScootRadar came from Google Play, or from GitHub or this repository before 18 November 2026, uninstall it first: the copies here are signed with a different key. Source code: https://github.com/plhery/ScootRadar

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plhery/ScootRadar/fdroid/repo

If you would like to manually verify the fingerprint (SHA-256) of the repository signing key, here it is:
